summary: Minimal, correct change adding params={'value': value} to the ModelChoiceField invalid_choice ValidationError, matching how ChoiceField and ModelMultipleChoiceField already supply the value. Mirrors the approach Django actually merged for this ticket.

issues.description: The default 'invalid_choice' message for ModelChoiceField still reads 'That choice is not one of the available choices.' and contains no %(value)s placeholder, so out of the box the value is not displayed; the params only take effect for custom/overridden messages. This is an intentional backward-compatible tradeoff (matches Django's merged fix) but means the literal issue request to 'modify the default error message' is not fully satisfied.
